rules: The first CSV header field must be the delivered unlabelled row index and the remaining six fields must match exactDeliveredSchema in exact order.
Every non-empty data row must contain exactly seven finite numeric fields including the delivered row index.
The delivered row index must be integer-like and contiguous from zero.
The delivered time vector must be strictly increasing and regularly stepped within each file; its engineering unit is not inferred.
State values must be integer-like, but observed codes are aggregated without assigning phase semantics.
Only melt_volume and injection_velocity enter accepted measured-value totals after a file passes all structural and time-vector checks.
Injection pressure target remains command evidence; injection pressure actual remains unit-blocked; state remains semantics-blocked.
Injection static_data.csv tables and screw-driving streams remain outside this time-series parser.
Any header, row-width, numeric, index or time-vector drift fails that upper serial file closed.

timing.resolutionRule: Preserve and validate each delivered file's explicit time vector. Do not assign a time engineering unit or impose the publisher's approximate global frequency where the source file differs.
